hash_note: SHA-256 shows each file is byte-for-byte the file the site was built from (identity and integrity). It does not show where the data came from or that it is correct.

ingestion.note: Counts as recorded in data/raw/retrieval_log.csv. Entries logged before Oct 2026 were written with 0 for dropped rows by the old code; the true number for those requests was not kept.

price_field: Every price is the "Close" field of MCX's daily Bhavcopy for that contract. We have not verified that this field equals MCX's official daily settlement price in every period, so the site calls it the Bhavcopy close.

specs.source: No source found for this period. Today's specification is carried back unchanged (assumption, not evidence).

tender_reported.source: FYERS notice "Precious metals expiry 5th August 2025: compulsory delivery contracts" (Gold, Gold Mini: staggered delivery tender period 5 days before expiry). No MCX circular cited.
FYERS notices for the 31 Oct 2025 and 28 Nov 2025 expiries (Gold Petal, Gold Guinea, Gold Ten: compulsory delivery, tender period 5 days before expiry). No MCX circular cited.

FYERS notice for the 27 Feb 2026 expiry (Gold Petal, Gold Guinea, Gold Ten: staggered delivery tender period starting 3 days before expiry). MCX circular MCX/TRD/040/2026 (27 Jan 2026) sets a 3-day staggered delivery period for the 1 kg GOLD contract; its text was seen only as a search excerpt.

rules.note: No row is marked official: MCX's website refuses automated requests, so no MCX circular or specification sheet could be read directly. Secondary means broker notices or exchange summaries; assumed means no source was found and today's specification is carried back.
